sentences.text:
Rup Md. Monibur Rahaman @ Monibur ... vs The State Of West
Bengal & Anr on 8 May, 2025

In The High Court At Calcutta
 No. 2025 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 12 Appellate Side
Ct 22 Crr 5193 of 2024

rup Md. Monibur Rahaman @ Monibur Rahaman & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Prosenjit Mukherjee,
 Ms. Babita Pramanik. ... for the petitioners.

entities.text: rup Md. Monibur Rahaman @ Monibur Rahaman
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
1 . 
This revisional application has been filed assailing the order dated 12.09.2024 passed in connection with G.R. Case No. 1365 of 2018 under Section 498A/323/ 307/ 406/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, wherein Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rampurhat Birbhum rejected an application filed on behalf of the accused under Section 167(5) of the Code of Criminal Procedure with a prayer for discharging the accused for non-submission of charge-sheet within statutory period.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rampurhat Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has submitted that prior to filing of the charge-sheet the application was filed before the Court.

3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has further submitted that one affidavit has already been filed on behalf of the de facto complainant stating, inter alia, that she started residing with her husband.

4. Having heard the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners as well as having gone through the documents annexed with the revisional application, the same stands admitted.
5. Petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the State through the office of the Public Prosecutor of this Court and also to serve notice upon the opposite party No.2 through speed post with A/D and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

6. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners also prayed for stay of the proceeding involved in this revisional application, otherwise the very purpose of filing of this revisional application shall be frustrated.
Rup Md. Monibur Rahaman @ Monibur ... vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57124105/
1 7.

entities.text: Rup Md. Monibur Rahaman @ Monibur ... vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Regard being had to the above, let the proceeding in connection with G.R. Case No. 1365 of 2018,
pending before the Learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rampurhat Birbhum be stayed for a limited period i.e till 31st July, 2025 or until further order whichever is earlier.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rampurhat Birbhum
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
8. Let the matter appear in the Combined Monthly List of July, 2025 under the heading "Contested Application".
(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
